info.name: Citrix NetScaler NITRO REST Authentication LB Virtual Server API
Citrix Netscaler List Load Balancing Virtual Servers

params.name: attrs
params.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to retrieve. Limits the response to only the specified fields for efficiency.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression in the format property1:value1,property2:value2 to restrict results to matching resources.

params.name: view
params.description: Controls the level of detail in the response. Summary returns a minimal set of properties; detail returns all properties.

params.name: count
params.description: When set to yes, returns only the count of matching resources instead of the full resource details.

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of resources to return per page for paginated responses.

params.name: pageno
params.description: Page number to retrieve in paginated responses.

items.docs: Retrieves all load balancing virtual server configurations. Supports filtering, pagination, attribute selection, and summary/detail views.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Create a Load Balancing Virtual Server

items.docs: Creates a new load balancing virtual server with the specified configuration. The name and servicetype properties are required. Supports bulk creation by passing an array.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get a Specific Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server.

params.name: attrs
params.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to retrieve. Limits the response to only the specified fields for efficiency.

items.docs: Retrieves the configuration of a specific load balancing virtual server identified by name.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Update a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server to update.

items.docs: Updates the configuration of an existing load balancing virtual server. Retrieve the current state, modify properties locally, and upload the complete updated state.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Delete a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a load balancing virtual server identified by name.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Bind a Service to a Load Balancing Virtual Server

items.docs: Binds a backend service to a load balancing virtual server, allowing the virtual server to distribute traffic to that service.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Get Service Bindings for a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server.

items.docs: Retrieves all services bound to a specific load balancing virtual server.

info.name: Citrix Netscaler Unbind a Service From a Load Balancing Virtual Server

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server.

params.name: args
params.description: Arguments to identify the service binding to remove, in the format servicename:svc_prod.

items.docs: Removes the binding between a service and a load balancing virtual server.
